description:
Located on the outskirts of Ipswich town centre is this one bedroom first floor maisonette. The property has electric heating, double glazing and parking.

Along with being in close proximity to Ipswich town centre and Ipswich mainline railway station the property offers good access to the A12/A14.

The property is accessed via a private entrance which has stairs to the first floor.

The sitting/dining room has three windows to the front and a hallway to the rear providing access to all further rooms.

The kitchen has a window to the rear and has a range of base and eye-level units, work surfaces, space for appliances including a washing machine and fridge/freezer. There is a built-in oven with electric hob and extractor.

The bathroom comprises a bath with shower over, basin and WC.

The bedroom has a Juliet balcony to the rear and a storage cupboard.

Outside
The front of the property is accessed via a private entrance with a low level brick wall and there is parking to the rear of the property. 



Directions

Please use a Sat Nav with the postcode IP1 2EG.

Important Information

Council tax band – A
Services – Mains water, drainage and electricity are connected
Tenure – Leasehold
EPC rating - D

Lease information
Length of lease – 88 years remaining on the lease
Service charge – £1,571.90 per annum
Ground rent – £150 per annum
Subject to confirmation from the management company and these charges are for the current year and maybe subject to change.
keyFeatures: Good access to A12/A14 and Mainline railway station
Suitable for first time buyers or investors
